identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Route operators to canonical Runtime v3 service control

values.task_boundary: Correct the stale operator route and disable misleading legacy Runtime lifecycle claims without reimplementing service ownership.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The runbook names the current-generation csm binary, stable live init path, and canonical launchd label.
AC-2: Read-only status guidance explains service_loaded, listener_ready, Guardian PID, Runtime PID, active init hash, and observability readiness.
AC-3: Obsolete service root and label are not presented as permanent Runtime authority.
AC-4: Legacy CSMctl Runtime verbs cannot emit authoritative pass and instead return a concise canonical-command message.
AC-5: CSMctl Observatory-only commands remain available and separate.
AC-6: Existing canonical ownership tests and new deterministic routing/docs guards pass without live service mutation.
AC-7: Shell syntax, diff hygiene, and independent exact-head review pass.
non_goals: Live Wuji restart or launchd changes
Cloud edge provider agent model or Observatory UI work
